results.title: Yemen Calls for Intensifying Regional Coordination over Maritime Navigation
results.description: The Yemeni delegation participating in the multinational maritime coalition, headed by Rear Admiral Abdul Khaliq Monser, called for unifying international efforts and intensifying regional coordination to confront threats targeting the security of maritime navigation. Monser stressed the importance of providing operational and technical support to restore the readiness of the Yemeni naval forces, enabling them to perform their duties in protecting territorial waters and international shipping lanes.
